The rules provided include "White things are red," so since Gary is white (fact), applying this rule gives us **Gary is red** (derived fact). Next, another rule states "If something is red and cold then it is blue." Gary is both red (derived) and cold (fact), so applying this rule yields **Gary is blue** (derived fact). Therefore, the statement "Gary is blue" logically follows from the given facts and rules.
